fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-ffbf3f20 at 96e14104 (attempt 8): go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestShipLocalGate -v passes its subtests unstable_runs_the_gate_in_the_worktree, stable_skips, no_gate_skips, failing_gate_fails_with_its_output (plus TestShipLocalGateOncePerHead); go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow passes, including TestShipChangeLocalGate, which checks a gate step before every push of ship-change.toml with on.fail to a fixer, and (new in this attempt) that gate-rebase-merge and rebase-merge fail through rebase-merge-gate-failed to gate-fix-merge, whose loop render-merge -> gate-push-merge -> push-merge (ship open-pr) -> wait-rebased-merge never returns to land or any pre-land step, sets max_visits on every step, and walks repeated gate failures ending only at gate-fix-merge's cap, which addresses quality cycle-3 f1 (land went over max_visits 1). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(ship-local-gate|run-ship-change-rebase|run-ship-change)$' passes (ship-local-gate shows rhiza.ship.localGate as a project setting with an empty default, then make check from git config after daemon set; run-ship-change-rebase now ends the post-land conflict at rebase-merge-gate-failed). Note: the scripts fail in the run's raw env only because GOTMPDIR puts the test binary under ~/code/rhiza, so rhiza init sees that repo; with RHIZA_* unset and GOTMPDIR/TMPDIR in the session scratchpad they pass. Read the diff of ship-change.toml, workflow_test.go and the txtar.
